title: ERRS Department Terms of Reference
summary: Mandate, structure and staff terms of reference for the four units of the ERRS Department.

about.vision: To be a leading force in environmental protection and radiation safety, fostering a healthy and sustainable Liberia through scientific excellence, regulatory compliance and community engagement.
about.mission: To safeguard public health and the environment by conducting rigorous research, monitoring environmental parameters, ensuring safe chemical and radiation management, and promoting sustainable waste and remediation practices.

units.name: Chemical Management Unit
units.head: Emmanuel Suah
units.remit: Chemical registration, importation, effluent, fumigation, disposal and transport licences; escorts; pollutant registry

units.name: Environmental Monitoring and Research Unit
units.head: Joseph F. Charles
units.remit: Water, soil, air and noise monitoring; laboratory analysis; lab accreditation; sachet water certification

units.name: Radiation Safety Unit
units.head: Varney E. Armah
units.remit: Radiation law, licences, inspections, source inventory, RAIS/RASIMS reporting to the IAEA

units.name: Waste and Remediation Unit
units.head: Margaret M. Beyslow
units.remit: Waste management licensing, facility monitoring, remediation and awareness
